rules.title: Final diagnosis recorded
rules.question: Does the discharge summary state the final (discharge) diagnosis?
rules.fix: Add a Discharge Diagnosis section naming the principal diagnosis and active secondary diagnoses.

rules.title: Outcome of hospitalization described
rules.question: Does the summary describe the hospital course and the outcome of the hospitalization?
rules.fix: Add a hospital course that states what was treated and how the patient responded.

rules.title: Condition at discharge stated
rules.question: Does the summary state the patient's condition at discharge (clinical status, mental status, activity)?
rules.fix: State the condition at discharge, including mental status and activity level.

rules.title: Disposition stated
rules.question: Does the record state where the patient was discharged to (home, home with services, SNF, rehab, hospice, another hospital)?
rules.fix: State the disposition, for example Home with home health services, or Skilled nursing facility.

rules.title: Follow-up care arranged with a timeframe
rules.question: Are follow-up appointments or instructions documented with who the patient should see and when?
rules.fix: List each follow-up visit with clinician or clinic and a date or timeframe (for example within 7 days).

rules.title: Primary care or follow-up clinician identified
rules.question: Is the patient's primary care provider (or the clinician responsible for follow-up) identified by name?
rules.fix: Name the PCP or the outpatient clinician who owns follow-up, with contact details.

rules.title: Discharge medication list present
rules.question: Is there a complete discharge medication list?
rules.fix: Add the reconciled discharge medication list with dose and frequency.

rules.title: Medication changes explained
rules.question: Does the record say which medications were started, stopped, or changed (or that there were no changes)?
rules.fix: Add a Medication Changes list: new, changed, and stopped medications with the reason.

rules.title: Pending results addressed
rules.question: Does the summary list test results still pending at discharge, or state that none are pending, and who will follow them up?
rules.fix: List results pending at discharge and who will follow them up, or write None pending.

rules.title: Goals of care and treatment preferences
patterns: \b(goals of care|code status|full code|DNR|DNI|POLST|MOLST|advance directive|treatment preferences?)\b
rules.question: Does the record document the patient's post-discharge goals of care and treatment preferences (for example code status, advance directive, stated goals)?
rules.fix: Document goals of care and treatment preferences, including code status.

rules.title: Functional status at discharge
rules.question: Does the record describe the patient's functional status or mobility at discharge?
rules.fix: Describe mobility and ability to perform daily activities at discharge.

rules.title: Summary sent to the next provider
rules.question: Is there evidence the discharge information was sent to the PCP or post-acute provider?
rules.fix: Document that the summary was transmitted to the PCP or receiving facility, and how.

rules.title: Discharge planning evaluation documented
rules.question: Is a discharge planning evaluation (likely post-hospital needs and their availability) documented?
rules.fix: Have case management document the discharge planning evaluation in the record.

rules.title: Plan discussed with patient or representative
rules.question: Does the record show the discharge plan or evaluation was discussed with the patient or their representative?
rules.fix: Document that the plan was discussed with the patient or representative and their response.

rules.title: Post-acute provider list presented
rules.question: For a referral to home health, SNF, IRF or LTCH: is it documented that the patient was given a list of available Medicare-participating providers?
rules.fix: Document that the Medicare-participating provider list was presented to the patient or representative.

rules.title: Patient choice of provider respected
rules.question: Is it documented that the patient was told of their freedom to choose a post-acute provider and that their choice was respected?
rules.fix: Document freedom of choice and which provider the patient chose.

rules.title: Quality data shared for provider choice
rules.question: Is it documented that quality and resource-use data were shared to help the patient choose a post-acute provider?
rules.fix: Document that quality data (for example Care Compare star ratings) was reviewed with the patient.

rules.title: Signed, dated and timed
rules.question: Is the discharge summary authenticated (signed), dated and timed?
rules.fix: Sign the summary electronically; the signature must carry a date and time.

rules.title: Completed within 30 days of discharge
rules.question: Was the record completed within 30 days of discharge?
rules.fix: Complete and sign the record; it is past or near the 30-day limit.

rules.title: Nursing instructions match the summary's medications
rules.question: Do the medications in the nursing discharge instructions match the discharge summary's medication list? Name any medication that appears in one but not the other.
rules.fix: Reconcile the nursing instructions and the physician summary so the patient receives one medication list.
